make-a-video-call.note: to call someone using a phone or computer so that you can see each other while you talk
make-a-video-call.tip: 动词用 make，不用 do 或 play；打给谁用 to sb 或直接说 video-call sb。
make-a-video-call.example: We make a video call to my grandma every Friday evening.
make-a-video-call.en: Then he put one big green button on the screen to make a video call.
make-a-video-call.szh: 然后在屏幕上放了一个大大的绿色按钮，专门用来打视频电话。

sign-in.note: to type your name and password so that you can use a website or an app
sign-in.tip: 登录到哪里用 sign in to；退出是 sign out。也常说 log in / log out。
sign-in.example: You need to sign in before you can leave a review.
sign-in.en: He even signed in to every app for them, so as not to get calls about lost passwords.
sign-in.szh: 他还替爸妈把每个 App 都登录好了，免得以后老接到「密码找不到了」的电话。

more.en: Some people can't sign in with their old email address.
more.szh: 有些人用原来的邮箱登录不了。

w-confuse.note: 形容词 confused（人觉得糊涂）、confusing（事情让人糊涂）。
w-confuse.en: Next, Chen wrote a one-page guide in Chinese, in order not to confuse his dad.
w-confuse.szh: 接着，小陈用中文写了一页说明，免得把爸爸弄糊涂。

switch-on.note: to make a machine, a light or a piece of equipment start working by pressing a button
switch-on.tip: 英式常用 switch on / off，美式多说 turn on / off；宾语是代词时放中间：switch it on。
switch-on.example: Can you switch on the heating? It's freezing in here.
switch-on.en: It had three steps: switch it on, press the green button, wait.
switch-on.szh: 一共三步：开机，按绿色按钮，等着。

get-sth-up-and-running.zh: 让（系统、设备）运转起来；弄好能用
get-sth-up-and-running.note: to make a machine, a system or a business start working properly
get-sth-up-and-running.tip: 也可以只说 be up and running（已经能用了）；常说的是系统、网站、项目这类东西。
get-sth-up-and-running.example: The new website should be up and running by Friday.
get-sth-up-and-running.en: To his surprise, his dad had got everything up and running in under a minute.
get-sth-up-and-running.szh: 没想到，爸爸不到一分钟就把一切都弄好了。

w-connect.note: 连 Wi-Fi 是 connect to the Wi-Fi；名词 connection。
w-connect.en: The call connected, and his mum's voice filled the room.
w-connect.szh: 电话一接通，屋里一下子全是妈妈的声音。

w-investor.note: 动词 invest in sth（投资）；名词 investment。
w-investor.en: Our investors have taken a real interest in it, too, so dark mode can wait.
w-investor.szh: 投资人对这个也特别感兴趣，所以深色模式可以往后放。

push-back-on.note: to disagree with an idea or a plan and argue against it
push-back-on.tip: 职场常用，语气比 disagree 委婉，意思是「这一点我有不同看法」；名词 pushback（反对意见）。
push-back-on.example: The team pushed back on the new deadline because it was too early.
push-back-on.en: Sorry, but I'm going to push back on that.
push-back-on.szh: 不好意思，这一点我不同意。

more.en: You pushed back on sharing in October.
more.szh: 十月份你反对先做分享。

w-offline.note: 这里当副词用：work offline；反义 online。
w-offline.en: Right now, sync doesn't work offline.
w-offline.szh: 现在没网的时候，同步是用不了的。

w-hire.note: 英式 hire 还有「租用」：hire a car。
w-hire.en: We're on a budget, and I can't hire anyone else.
w-hire.szh: 我们预算紧，我没法再招人了。

first-things-first.zh: 先办最要紧的事；一件一件来
first-things-first.note: something you say when you think the most important thing should be done before anything else
first-things-first.tip: 固定说法，常放在句首，后面接要先做的事；things 用复数。
first-things-first.example: First things first: has everyone got a coffee?
first-things-first.en: Well, we didn't, so first things first.
first-things-first.szh: 可我们没有啊，所以先办最要紧的。

come-up-with.note: to think of an idea, a plan or an answer
come-up-with.tip: 后面接 idea / plan / solution / name 这类词；不说 come up a plan，with 不能丢。
come-up-with.example: We need to come up with a name for the new café.
come-up-with.en: OK, I've come up with a plan.

reach-a-compromise.note: to agree on something after both sides accept less than they first wanted
reach-a-compromise.tip: 动词用 reach，也可以说 come to a compromise；compromise 读 /ˈkɒmprəmaɪz/。
reach-a-compromise.example: After an hour of talking, the two families reached a compromise.
reach-a-compromise.en: I think we've just reached a compromise.
reach-a-compromise.szh: 我看我们算是各让了一步。

w-compromise.note: 也能当动词：We both had to compromise。
w-compromise.en: I think we've just reached a compromise.
w-compromise.szh: 我看我们算是各让了一步。

that-works-for-me.note: something you say to agree to a plan, a time or an idea
that-works-for-me.tip: 约时间、定方案时很常用；问对方可以说 Does that work for you?
that-works-for-me.example: "Shall we meet at ten?" "That works for me."

at-the-end-of-the-day.text: at the end of the day
at-the-end-of-the-day.note: used to say what is most important after you have thought about everything
at-the-end-of-the-day.tip: 口语里很常用，不是「傍晚」的意思；正式写作里少用。
at-the-end-of-the-day.example: At the end of the day, it's your money, so it's your choice.
at-the-end-of-the-day.en: At the end of the day, it has to work.
at-the-end-of-the-day.szh: 说到底，东西得能用才行。

w-notification.note: 动词 notify（通知）比较正式；关掉通知是 turn off notifications。
w-notification.en: The feature people asked for most is a button to turn off our notifications.
w-notification.szh: 大家最想要的功能，是一个能把我们的通知关掉的按钮。

block-out.note: to stop light or sound from reaching somewhere
block-out.tip: 宾语是代词时放中间：block it out；也可以说不去想某事：block out bad memories。
block-out.example: Thick curtains block out the light from the street.
block-out.en: Well, noise-cancelling headphones block out sound by listening to it first.
block-out.szh: 其实，降噪耳机挡住声音的办法，是先去「听」它。

w-chip.note: 英式里 chips 还是「炸薯条」，薯片是 crisps。
w-chip.en: A chip makes a new sound by copying that noise and turning it upside down.
w-chip.szh: 芯片把这些噪音复制一份，再上下翻过来，做出一个新的声音。

w-opposite.note: 也常作形容词：the opposite direction（相反方向）。
w-opposite.en: So the new wave is the exact opposite.
w-opposite.szh: 这样，新的声波就正好跟原来的相反。

w-wave.note: 声波 sound wave；也是「海浪」「挥手」。
w-wave.en: When the two waves meet, they cancel each other out.
w-wave.szh: 两列声波一碰上，就互相抵消了。

cancel-each-other-out.note: if two things cancel each other out, they have opposite effects, so together they have no effect
cancel-each-other-out.tip: 英式拼写 cancelled、cancelling 双写 l；也可以说 A cancels out B。
cancel-each-other-out.example: My pay rise and the higher rent just cancel each other out.
cancel-each-other-out.en: When the two waves meet, they cancel each other out.
cancel-each-other-out.szh: 两列声波一碰上，就互相抵消了。

in-other-words.note: used when you say something again in a simpler or clearer way
in-other-words.tip: 用来把前面的话说得更简单、更直白；放句首，后面加逗号。
in-other-words.example: The meeting has been moved to Friday — in other words, we've got two more days.
in-other-words.en: In other words, your headphones make silence by adding more sound.
in-other-words.szh: 换句话说，耳机是靠多加一点声音来制造安静的。

work-wonders.note: to have a very good effect on something
work-wonders.tip: 对什么管用用 for 或 on；wonders 一定用复数。
work-wonders.example: A short walk after lunch works wonders for my back.
work-wonders.en: This works wonders on low, steady noise, like a train engine or an air conditioner.
work-wonders.szh: 对低沉、平稳的噪音，比如火车发动机、空调，这一招特别管用。

w-steady.note: a steady job 稳定的工作。
w-steady.en: This works wonders on low, steady noise, like a train engine or an air conditioner.
w-steady.szh: 对低沉、平稳的噪音，比如火车发动机、空调，这一招特别管用。

w-sudden.note: 副词 suddenly；all of a sudden 突然。
w-sudden.en: Voices and other sudden, high sounds change too quickly to follow.
w-sudden.szh: 人说话的声音，还有别的突然、尖细的声音，变得太快，芯片跟不上。

as-a-result.note: because of the thing that has just been mentioned
as-a-result.tip: 放在第二句开头说结果；要说原因用 as a result of + 名词：as a result of the storm。
as-a-result.example: The trains were cancelled. As a result, half the team worked from home.
as-a-result.en: As a result, they still get through.
as-a-result.szh: 所以这些声音还是会钻进耳朵。

drown-out.zh: （声音大得）盖过、淹没（别的声音）
drown-out.note: to be so loud that another sound cannot be heard
drown-out.tip: 主语是更大的声音；宾语是代词时放中间：drown them out。drown 本义是「淹死」。
drown-out.example: The music was so loud that it drowned out our conversation.
drown-out.en: That's why lots of people play music to drown them out.
drown-out.szh: 这就是为什么很多人还会放点音乐，把它们盖住。

out-of-the-blue.note: suddenly and when nobody expects it
out-of-the-blue.tip: 放在句尾最常见；blue 指晴朗的天空，晴天里打雷，意想不到。
out-of-the-blue.example: An old friend called me out of the blue last week.
out-of-the-blue.en: It's 10:47, the website's gone down out of the blue, and we go live in ten hours!
out-of-the-blue.szh: 现在晚上 10 点 47，网站突然挂了，我们十个小时以后就要上线了！

w-refresh.note: 这里当名词用，指刷新一次；动词是 refresh the page。
w-refresh.szh: 你每刷新一次，它就更糟一点。

w-hacker.note: 动词 hack into sth（黑进……）。

w-log.note: 开发里常用复数 logs；log in 是「登录」。
w-log.en: Instead of guessing, let's look at the logs.
w-log.szh: 别瞎猜了，我们看看日志。

w-alarm.note: 闹钟是 alarm clock；set an alarm 定闹钟。
w-alarm.en: My phone woke me at 4:17 with a server alarm, so I got up to check.
w-alarm.szh: 凌晨 4 点 17，手机上的服务器警报把我吵醒了，我就起来看看。

talk-sb-through-sth.zh: 一步步给某人讲解、带着某人做
talk-sb-through-sth.note: to explain to someone how to do something, one step at a time, while they do it
talk-sb-through-sth.tip: sb 放在 talk 和 through 中间；也可以只讲不做：talk sb through the plan（把计划给某人讲一遍）。
talk-sb-through-sth.example: The nurse talked me through what would happen during the operation.
talk-sb-through-sth.en: Arjun, can you talk me through the server settings?
talk-sb-through-sth.szh: Arjun，你能一步步带我改一下服务器设置吗？

own-up-to.zh: 承认（自己做错的事）；坦白
own-up-to.note: to admit that you have done something wrong
own-up-to.tip: 后面接名词或 doing：own up to eating the cake；没有宾语时只说 own up：Come on, own up!
own-up-to.example: Nobody owned up to breaking the printer.
own-up-to.en: I have to own up to something.

breathe-a-sigh-of-relief.note: to feel happy and relaxed because something bad did not happen or has ended
breathe-a-sigh-of-relief.tip: breathe 是动词，读 /briːð/；breath 是名词，读 /breθ/，别拼混。
breathe-a-sigh-of-relief.example: When the plane landed safely, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
breathe-a-sigh-of-relief.en: We can all breathe a sigh of relief.
breathe-a-sigh-of-relief.szh: 大家都可以松一口气了。

w-relief.note: What a relief!（总算放心了！）形容词 relieved。
w-relief.en: We can all breathe a sigh of relief.
w-relief.szh: 大家都可以松一口气了。

call-it-a-night.note: to stop what you are doing for the rest of the evening
call-it-a-night.tip: 常用 Let's call it a night；白天收工说 call it a day。
call-it-a-night.example: It's nearly midnight. Shall we call it a night?
call-it-a-night.en: Let's call it a night instead of staring at graphs.
call-it-a-night.szh: 今天就到这儿吧，别再盯着那些图表了。

w-graph.en: Let's call it a night instead of staring at graphs.
w-graph.szh: 今天就到这儿吧，别再盯着那些图表了。

fingers-crossed.note: something you say when you hope that something will happen in the way you want
fingers-crossed.tip: 来自把中指叠在食指上祈求好运的手势；完整说法是 keep your fingers crossed。
fingers-crossed.example: My interview is at ten. Fingers crossed!

w-forum.note: 读 /ˈfɔːrəm/；在论坛发帖是 post on a forum。
w-forum.en: "Sorry, love. I only shared it with my gardening forum.
w-forum.szh: 「对不起啊，宝贝。我就发到了我们的园艺论坛上。

w-smartwatch.note: smart + watch 合成一个词；智能手机 smartphone 也是这样。
w-smartwatch.en: One in four UK adults now wear a smartwatch to bed, according to a survey of 2,000 people.
w-smartwatch.szh: 一项针对 2000 人的调查显示，现在每四个英国成年人里，就有一个戴着智能手表睡觉。

w-measure.en: Once you stop moving, it starts measuring your heart rate.
w-measure.szh: 你一不动，它就开始测你的心率。

can-t-live-without-sth.zh: 离不开……；没有……就活不下去
can-t-live-without-sth.note: to feel that you need something very much and could not manage if you did not have it
can-t-live-without-sth.tip: 口语里的夸张说法，常说手机、咖啡这类东西；可以换成 couldn't live without sth。
can-t-live-without-sth.example: I can't live without coffee in the morning.
can-t-live-without-sth.en: "I can't live without it," she told us.
can-t-live-without-sth.szh: 「我已经完全离不开它了，」她跟我们说。

be-obsessed-with.note: to think about something or someone all the time, more than is normal
be-obsessed-with.tip: 介词用 with；比 be fascinated by 程度更重，常带点「过头了」的意思。读 /əbˈsest/。
be-obsessed-with.example: My brother is obsessed with football.
be-obsessed-with.en: Sleep researchers say some people are becoming obsessed with their scores.
be-obsessed-with.szh: 睡眠研究者说，有些人正变得对分数着了魔。

w-obsessed.en: Sleep researchers say some people are becoming obsessed with their scores.
w-obsessed.szh: 睡眠研究者说，有些人正变得对分数着了魔。

have-a-bad-night.note: to sleep badly during the night
have-a-bad-night.tip: night 前面的形容词可以换：have a good night / a late night / a sleepless night。
have-a-bad-night.example: Sorry I'm quiet today — I had a bad night.
have-a-bad-night.en: "If the watch says you've had a bad night, you feel tired, even when you slept well.
have-a-bad-night.szh: 「手表说你昨晚没睡好，你就觉得累，哪怕你其实睡得不错。

w-wrist.note: w 不发音，读 /rɪst/；手表也叫 wristwatch。
w-wrist.en: I'd be grateful if people listened to their bodies instead of checking their wrists."
w-wrist.szh: 我希望大家多听听自己身体的感觉，别老盯着手腕。」

be-tempted-to.note: to want to do something, especially something you know you should not do
be-tempted-to.tip: 后面接动词原形；也可以 be tempted by sth（被……吸引）。
be-tempted-to.example: I was tempted to leave the meeting early.
be-tempted-to.en: Gemma admits she's often tempted to check the app at 3 am.
be-tempted-to.szh: Gemma 承认，她半夜三点也常常忍不住想看一眼 App。

take-sth-off.note: to remove a piece of clothing, a watch or jewellery from your body
take-sth-off.tip: 宾语是代词时放中间：take it off；反义 put sth on。
take-sth-off.example: Please take your shoes off at the door.
take-sth-off.en: So last month, she took it off for a week.
take-sth-off.szh: 所以上个月，她把手表摘了一个星期。

in-the-first-place.note: used to talk about the reason why something was done at the beginning
in-the-first-place.tip: 常放在句尾，带一点「早知道就不……」的意思；列举时 In the first place 是「首先」。
in-the-first-place.example: Why did you buy it in the first place if you don't like it?
in-the-first-place.en: Now she wonders why she started wearing it in the first place.
in-the-first-place.szh: 现在她都想不明白，自己当初为什么要戴它。

w-endless.en: And endless feeds are built so that you never reach the bottom.
w-endless.szh: 没有尽头的信息流，也是故意做成让你永远刷不到底的。

be-hooked-on.note: to like something so much that you find it hard to stop doing or using it
be-hooked-on.tip: 口语说法，比 addicted to 轻松；后面接名词或 doing：be hooked on playing chess。
be-hooked-on.example: My dad is hooked on a TV quiz show.
be-hooked-on.en: By February this year, I was completely hooked on my phone.
be-hooked-on.szh: 到今年二月，我已经彻底离不开手机了。

browse-through.note: to look through a website, a feed, a magazine or a shop without looking for anything special
browse-through.tip: 说的是随便看看、不找特定的东西；在店里「只是看看」说 I'm just browsing。
browse-through.example: I browsed through a few cookbooks while I waited.
browse-through.en: I'd browse through my feed on the way to work, at lunch, in bed.
browse-through.szh: 上班路上刷，午饭时刷，躺床上也刷。

w-feed.note: 动词 feed 是「喂」；新闻推送也叫 news feed。
w-feed.en: I'd browse through my feed on the way to work, at lunch, in bed.
w-feed.szh: 上班路上刷，午饭时刷，躺床上也刷。

out-of-habit.note: because you always do it, not because you have decided to
out-of-habit.tip: out of 在这里表示原因，同类说法还有 out of interest（出于好奇）、out of kindness。
out-of-habit.example: I still set my alarm for six out of habit, even on Sundays.
out-of-habit.en: I even checked it at traffic lights, just out of habit.
out-of-habit.szh: 连等红灯都要看一眼，纯粹是习惯了。

w-delete.note: 删 App 也常说 uninstall；名词 deletion。
w-delete.en: So on the first of March, I deleted every social media app to see what would happen.
w-delete.szh: 所以 3 月 1 号，我把所有社交 App 都删了，看看会怎么样。

miss-out-on.note: to not have the chance to enjoy something that other people are enjoying
miss-out-on.tip: on 后面接错过的东西；没有宾语时说 miss out：I don't want to miss out。
miss-out-on.example: Don't miss out on the free tickets — they go fast.
miss-out-on.en: In the first week, I was sure I was missing out on everything.
miss-out-on.szh: 第一个星期，我总觉得自己错过了所有事。

w-engaged.note: 英式电话占线也说 engaged：The line is engaged。
w-engaged.en: My cousin got engaged, and I heard about it from my mum two days later.
w-engaged.szh: 我表妹订婚了，我是两天后才从我妈那儿听说的。

get-through-sth.zh: 读完；用完；做完（一定量的东西）
get-through-sth.note: to finish or use a large amount of something
get-through-sth.tip: 英式过去分词用 got：had got through。另一个常见意思是「熬过（难关）」：get through a hard week。
get-through-sth.example: We got through three pots of tea during the meeting.
get-through-sth.en: I'd got through two novels on the bus.
get-through-sth.szh: 我在公交车上读完了两本小说。

w-novel.note: 小说家是 novelist；短篇小说是 short story。
w-novel.en: I'd got through two novels on the bus.
w-novel.szh: 我在公交车上读完了两本小说。

go-without.note: to manage without something that you usually have or want
go-without.tip: 后面接名词；比 do without 更强调「缺了它、忍一忍」。
go-without.example: I went without coffee for a week, and I was terrible company.
go-without.en: Going without likes was much easier than I'd thought.
go-without.szh: 没有点赞的日子，比我想的容易多了。

w-designer.en: So, for any designers listening, apps should be built to let people leave, not just to keep them.
w-designer.szh: 所以，给正在听的设计师们说一句：App 应该做得让人走得开，而不只是想方设法留住人。

w-remove.note: 比 take away 正式；名词 removal。
w-remove.en: Look out for the red dots in your own work, because most of them can be removed.
w-remove.szh: 留意一下你们自己产品里的小红点，大部分其实都可以去掉。

w-roof.en: He usually waits twenty minutes at a stop with no roof.
w-roof.szh: 他通常要在一个没顶棚的车站等二十分钟。

w-umbrella.en: He's lost three umbrellas on that bus, and he's never got one back.
w-umbrella.szh: 他在那趟车上丢过三把伞，一把都没找回来。

show-sb-how-to-do.zh: 教某人怎么做；给某人示范
show-sb-how-to-do.note: to teach someone to do something by doing it in front of them or explaining it step by step
show-sb-how-to-do.tip: sb 放在 show 后面，how to 后面接动词原形；不说 show sb to do。
show-sb-how-to-do.example: Can you show me how to change the printer settings?
show-sb-how-to-do.en: So on Sunday, during their video call on the new tablet, Chen decided to show him how to use a taxi app.
show-sb-how-to-do.szh: 所以星期天用新平板视频的时候，小陈决定教爸爸用打车软件。

w-confirm.note: 名词 confirmation；订单确认邮件是 a confirmation email。
w-confirm.en: He typed in an address and went back and forth between "Confirm" and "Cancel" for a whole minute.
w-confirm.szh: 他输了一个地址，在「确认」和「取消」之间来回犹豫了整整一分钟。

be-on-its-way.note: to be travelling towards a place and arriving soon
be-on-its-way.tip: its 跟着主语变：I'm on my way、they're on their way；外卖、打车软件里常见。
be-on-its-way.example: Your food is on its way — it should arrive in ten minutes.
be-on-its-way.en: A message came up: a white car driven by a Mr Guo was on its way.
be-on-its-way.szh: 屏幕上跳出一条消息：一位姓郭的师傅开着一辆白色的车，正在赶来。

pull-up.note: if a vehicle pulls up, it stops somewhere for a short time
pull-up.tip: 主语是车或开车的人；停在哪儿用 outside / in front of / at。
pull-up.example: A taxi pulled up in front of the hotel.
pull-up.en: Four minutes later, the car pulled up outside the gate.
pull-up.szh: 四分钟后，车停在了小区大门外。

w-gate.en: Four minutes later, the car pulled up outside the gate.
w-gate.szh: 四分钟后，车停在了小区大门外。

w-courtyard.note: court + yard；指楼房围起来的空地。
w-courtyard.en: The neighbours sitting in the courtyard all stopped talking to watch.
w-courtyard.szh: 坐在院子里的邻居们都不说话了，全都看着。

drop-sb-off.note: to take someone somewhere in a car and leave them there
drop-sb-off.tip: sb 是代词时放中间：drop me off；反过来「去接人」是 pick sb up。
drop-sb-off.example: I'll drop you off at the station on my way to work.
drop-sb-off.en: Mr Guo would drop him off right outside the club.
drop-sb-off.szh: 郭师傅会把他直接送到俱乐部门口。

in-no-time.tip: 可放句首或句尾；也说 in next to no time，更强调快。
in-no-time.example: Don't worry, the kids will be asleep in no time.
in-no-time.en: He'd be there in no time.

give-sb-a-lift.note: to take someone somewhere in your car
give-sb-a-lift.tip: 英式说法；美式多说 give sb a ride。lift 在英式里也是「电梯」。
give-sb-a-lift.example: Could you give me a lift to the airport tomorrow?
give-sb-a-lift.en: And he'd never have to ask anyone to give him a lift again.
give-sb-a-lift.szh: 以后他再也不用求人捎他一程了。

w-block.note: 一栋公寓楼英式叫 a block of flats。
w-block.en: The white car went slowly round the block and stopped outside the same gate again.
w-block.szh: 那辆白色的车慢慢绕着街区开了一圈，又停在了同一个大门外。

be-affected-by.note: to be changed or harmed by something
be-affected-by.tip: affect 是动词，effect 是名词，别拼混；受影响的人可以直接说 everyone affected。
be-affected-by.example: Thousands of people were affected by the train strike.
be-affected-by.en: About two per cent of you were affected by it.
be-affected-by.szh: 大约百分之二的用户受到了影响。

follow-the-instructions.note: to do what the written or spoken steps tell you to do
follow-the-instructions.tip: instructions 用复数；说明书英式也叫 instructions，不用 instruction book。
follow-the-instructions.example: If you follow the instructions on the box, it takes ten minutes.
follow-the-instructions.en: Follow the instructions under this video.
follow-the-instructions.szh: 照着视频下面的步骤做就行。

w-restore.note: 恢复数据 restore data；也指修复老房子、老家具。
w-restore.en: Open the app, then tap "Restore my list" in Settings.
w-restore.szh: 打开 App，然后在「设置」里点「恢复我的清单」。

w-programme.note: 英式拼写；电脑「程序」不管英美都写 program。
w-programme.en: If you enrolled on our beta programme in October, the fix is already there.
w-programme.szh: 如果你十月报名参加了我们的测试计划，修复已经自动完成了。

for-the-time-being.note: for a short time, until something changes
for-the-time-being.tip: 说的是「先这样，以后可能会变」；放句首或句尾都行。
for-the-time-being.example: You can use my desk for the time being.
for-the-time-being.en: For the time being, we've also turned off the new invite link we added on Friday.
for-the-time-being.szh: 另外，星期五新加的邀请链接，我们也暂时先关掉了。

make-up-for.note: to do something good because something bad has happened
make-up-for.tip: for 后面接要弥补的事；没有 for 的 make up 是「编造」或「和好」，意思完全不同。
make-up-for.example: He bought her flowers to make up for forgetting her birthday.
make-up-for.en: To make up for it, everyone affected will get a free three-month pass to Rota Plus.
make-up-for.szh: 作为补偿，每位受影响的用户都能免费用三个月 Rota Plus。

rest-assured.note: used to tell someone that they do not need to worry about something
rest-assured.tip: 正式说法，常见于客服邮件、公告；口语里说 Don't worry 就行。
rest-assured.example: Rest assured, your bags will be on the next flight.
rest-assured.en: You can rest assured that your data was never shared with anyone outside the team.
rest-assured.szh: 请放心，你们的数据从来没有给团队以外的任何人看过。

w-data.note: 英式读 /ˈdeɪtə/；日常当不可数名词用，动词用单数。
w-data.en: You can rest assured that your data was never shared with anyone outside the team.
w-data.szh: 请放心，你们的数据从来没有给团队以外的任何人看过。

drop-sb-a-line.zh: 给某人写几句话；捎个信
drop-sb-a-line.note: to send someone a short letter, email or message
drop-sb-a-line.tip: 口语、比较随意；line 指「几行字」，不是电话线。
drop-sb-a-line.example: Drop me a line when you get back from Spain.
drop-sb-a-line.en: If the fix doesn't work as described, drop me a line, and I'll reply myself.
drop-sb-a-line.szh: 要是照着做了还是不行，给我写两句就好，我亲自回。

w-dorm.note: dormitory 的简称；英国学生更常说 halls（of residence）。
w-dorm.en: When I was at university, I lived in a six-person dorm room with six very different ideas about cleaning.
w-dorm.szh: 我上大学时住六人间宿舍，六个人对打扫卫生的看法，六个样。

w-stain.en: But we did have to learn to live with the coffee stains.
w-stain.szh: 不过，上面的咖啡渍我们也只好忍了。

it-all-started-when.zh: 一切要从……说起；事情是从……开始的
it-all-started-when.note: used to begin telling the story of how something began
it-all-started-when.tip: 讲故事、演讲开头的常用说法，when 后面用一般过去时。
it-all-started-when.example: It all started when my sister gave me an old camera.
it-all-started-when.en: It all started when my three flatmates and I got sick of arguing about the bins.
it-all-started-when.szh: 一切要从我和三个室友为倒垃圾吵烦了说起。

be-sick-of.note: to be bored with or annoyed by something because it has happened too often
be-sick-of.tip: 后面接名词或 doing；语气比 be tired of 更重，口语常说 sick and tired of。
be-sick-of.example: I'm sick of eating sandwiches for lunch every day.
be-sick-of.en: It all started when my three flatmates and I got sick of arguing about the bins.
be-sick-of.szh: 一切要从我和三个室友为倒垃圾吵烦了说起。

w-bin.note: 英式说 bin，美式说 trash can；take the bins out 是把垃圾桶推到路边等收。
w-bin.en: It all started when my three flatmates and I got sick of arguing about the bins.
w-bin.szh: 一切要从我和三个室友为倒垃圾吵烦了说起。

w-fair.note: That's not fair!（不公平！）名词 fairness。
w-fair.en: So we put a list on the fridge to keep things fair.
w-fair.szh: 所以为了公平，我们在冰箱上贴了一张值日表。

w-menu.en: We couldn't get over how quickly it disappeared under pizza menus.
w-menu.szh: 没想到它那么快就被一堆披萨菜单盖住了。

w-interview.note: 做产品时的用户访谈叫 user interviews；也是「面试」。
w-interview.en: It took us fourteen months and two hundred interviews to get the app off the ground.
w-interview.szh: 我们花了十四个月、做了两百次访谈，才让这个 App 做起来。

get-sth-off-the-ground.zh: 让（计划、项目）启动起来、做成
get-sth-off-the-ground.note: to make a plan or a project start and begin to succeed
get-sth-off-the-ground.tip: 常说新公司、新项目、新产品；也可以说 sth gets off the ground（启动了）。
get-sth-off-the-ground.example: It took us a year to get the café off the ground.
get-sth-off-the-ground.en: It took us fourteen months and two hundred interviews to get the app off the ground.
get-sth-off-the-ground.szh: 我们花了十四个月、做了两百次访谈，才让这个 App 做起来。

make-life-easier.note: to make things less difficult for someone
make-life-easier.tip: 为谁轻松用 for sb；也可以说 make sb's life easier。反过来是 make life difficult for sb。
make-life-easier.example: A dishwasher would make life easier for all of us.
make-life-easier.en: It's much harder to make life easier for four tired people in a kitchen.
make-life-easier.szh: 要让厨房里四个累坏了的人日子好过一点，就难多了。

last-but-not-least.note: used when you mention the last person or thing in a list, to say they are just as important as the others
last-but-not-least.tip: 致谢、介绍人时放在最后一项前面；书面报告里少用，演讲、颁奖很常见。
last-but-not-least.example: Last but not least, thanks to my parents for all their help.
last-but-not-least.en: And last but not least, thank you to Chen and Arjun, who actually built it.
last-but-not-least.szh: 最后还要特别感谢真正把它做出来的小陈和 Arjun。

take-a-look-at.note: to look at something, often quickly
take-a-look-at.tip: 比 look at 客气、随意；也常说 have a look at（英式）。
take-a-look-at.example: Can you take a look at my report before I send it?
take-a-look-at.en: Right, please take a look at the big screen for the live demo.
take-a-look-at.szh: 好，请大家看大屏幕，我们现场演示。

w-clap.note: clapping 要双写 p；掌声也说 applause。
w-clap.en: Yes, Freya, I can hear you clapping in the front row.
w-clap.szh: 是的，Freya，我听见你在第一排鼓掌了。

w-launch.note: 也能当动词：launch an app；上线派对是 launch party。
w-launch.en: Right, it's been one month since launch.

w-rating.note: 动词 rate（打分）；应用商店里的「评分和评论」是 ratings and reviews。
w-rating.en: Twelve thousand downloads and a 4.6 rating so far.
w-rating.szh: 目前一万两千次下载，评分 4.6。

on-the-whole.note: used when you are talking about something in general, not about every detail
on-the-whole.tip: 放句首加逗号最常见；和 as a whole（作为一个整体）不一样。
on-the-whole.example: On the whole, the trip was a success.
on-the-whole.en: On the whole, it's gone down well with users.
on-the-whole.szh: 总的来说，用户挺满意的。

go-down-well-with.note: if something goes down well with people, they like it
go-down-well-with.tip: 反过来是 go down badly with；完成时是 has gone down well。
go-down-well-with.example: His speech went down well with the audience.
go-down-well-with.en: On the whole, it's gone down well with users.
go-down-well-with.szh: 总的来说，用户挺满意的。

w-invisible.en: That's the best review you can get for a feature designed to be invisible.
w-invisible.szh: 一个本来就设计成让人感觉不到的功能，这就是最好的评价了。

make-the-right-call.zh: 做出正确的决定；判断对了
make-the-right-call.note: to make a good decision, especially a difficult one
make-the-right-call.tip: call 在这里是「决定」；做错了是 make the wrong call；常说 It's your call（你来定）。
make-the-right-call.example: Leaving early was the right call — the roads were empty.
make-the-right-call.en: And you made the right call by putting sync first.
make-the-right-call.szh: 把同步放在前面，这个决定你做对了。

w-tap.note: 也能当动词：tap the button；英式 tap 还是「水龙头」。
w-tap.en: And we could add a button so that two people can trade a job in one tap.
w-tap.szh: 我们还可以加个按钮，让两个人点一下就能换活儿。

take-sth-on-board.note: to listen to an idea or a criticism and use it
take-sth-on-board.tip: 职场常用，表示「意见我听进去了」；sth 是代词时放中间：take it on board。
take-sth-on-board.example: Thanks for the feedback — we'll take it on board.

be-worth-it.note: if something is worth it, the good result is more important than the time, money or effort it cost
be-worth-it.tip: worth 后面直接接 it，不加 to；值得做某事是 be worth doing。
be-worth-it.example: The tickets were expensive, but the concert was worth it.
be-worth-it.en: Well, all those late nights were worth it.
be-worth-it.szh: 好吧，那些熬夜的晚上没白熬。

can-t-complain.zh: 还不错；没什么可抱怨的
can-t-complain.note: used to say that things are going well enough
can-t-complain.tip: 英式口语里回答 How are things? 的常见说法，省掉了主语 I，语气轻松、低调。
can-t-complain.szh: 挺好的，没什么可抱怨的。

w-ruin.note: 夸张的口语里很常见：You've ruined the surprise!
w-ruin.en: And the one right below it, from the same flat, one star: "This app has ruined my life."
w-ruin.szh: 就在它下面那条，来自同一套公寓，一星：「这个 App 毁了我的生活。」
